pull.title: KAFKA-21291: Remove unused code from AbstractConsumerTest
pull.body:
Most consumer tests have been moved to Java, most recently
PlaintextConsumerAssignorsTest in #23708. As a result, many helpers in
AbstractConsumerTest no longer have callers. This removes them, along
with the optional parameters and code paths that no remaining test uses.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
